# @vllnt/convex-memberships

> TypeScript Convex component for memberships and roles: a flat ReBAC relationship graph with membership checks, paginated member lists and React hooks.

Install `@vllnt/convex-memberships` (builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; React `>=18` is optional and only
needed for `./react`. Mount it with `app.use(memberships)` from
`@vllnt/convex-memberships/convex.config` and call it through
`new Memberships(components.memberships)` from host mutations and queries. An
edge is `(memberRef, resourceRef, relation)` with an opaque `memberKind`
(default `"user"`) and an optional opaque `status`; `add` and `remove` default
`relation` to `"member"`, while `listMembers` and `isMember` treat an omitted
`relation` as any relation. Methods: `add`, `remove`, `setRelation`, `listMembers`, `members`,
`isMember`, `documents`. React hooks: `useIsMember`, `useMembers`,
`useListMembers` (the two list hooks load the first 100 rows only). `add` is idempotent on the tuple and
overwrites `memberKind` and `status` on re-add. `setRelation` returns
`{ ok: false, reason }` (`NOT_FOUND`, `EXISTS`) instead of throwing. Writes
throw `ConvexError` with `data.code` `INVALID_ARGUMENT` for an empty string;
listing queries throw `INVALID_PAGE_SIZE` unless `numItems` is an integer from
1 through 1000 and `maximumRowsRead`, if given, is a positive integer (it is
capped at 1000). `isMember` without
`relation` returns `true` for any stored relation, including `"invited"` or
`"banned"`: do not use it as an authorization check. Edges are flat: no
transitive group expansion. The component never reads auth; the host
authorizes every call and protects the last owner.

## When to use

- Use it when users or groups belong to orgs, teams or workspaces with a role.
- Use it when you share resources (documents, projects) and must list who has
  access, or what one member can reach.
- Do not use it when a group is short-lived (one match, lobby, room or cohort)
  and needs a capacity limit, an open/locked/closed lifecycle or batched erase:
  use [`@vllnt/convex-buckets`](https://oss.vllnt.com/packages/convex-buckets).
- Do not use it when you need to decide what a role may do (action grants,
  deny by default): use
  [`@vllnt/convex-permissions`](https://oss.vllnt.com/packages/convex-permissions).
- Do not use it when nested groups must resolve for you (a member of a group
  that is a member of an org): edges are flat, so walk them with `members`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-memberships/`
(`README.md`, `docs/API.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `llms.txt`) and match the installed
version.
Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing code. The links below to `./`
paths are files inside the installed package.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Install, quick start, common tasks, limits, security
- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Every export, signature, default, return shape and validation rule
- [Errors and fixes](./README.md#errors-and-fixes): Every error code and `setRelation` reason, its cause and the fix
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-memberships/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, validation commands, release workflow (repository only)

## Examples
